item.title: 2 with life-threatening injuries in Liberty after burglary report
item.description: LIBERTY, N.C. (WGHP) -- Two people have life-threatening injuries in Liberty after deputies responded to a report of a burglary on Tuesday night. FOX8 is told that deputies and EMS responded to Hollow Tree Drive after being called around 8:30 p.m. This is a developing story.
